description: Details required by Condition 5 (submission of details - a) Long and short cross section and plans at 1:50; b)Section and elevation details of the external envelope including parapet junctions at 1:10; c) Elevational and sectional details of all external doors at 1:10; d) Plan and section details of the rooflights at 1:10; Details of any external lighting to the building) and Condition 6 (submission of materials - a) Samples of materials to be used on all of the external faces of the building(to be provided on site), including a typical transom/mullion/glazing junction, a typical scalloped panel, typical embossed metal panel and typical louvred panel; b) Sample of materials to be used on the roof including rooflights and all other roof surfaces (to be provided on site)) of planning permission PP/22/06343 (Removal of rooftop plant enclosures and equipment, and replacement with two-storey rooftop bar of up to 935sqm (GIA) and associated engineering and ancillary works)
